project: Interactive Map - Server Component Performance Optimization
description: Optimize Server Components to achieve <20ms compile + render times (currently 1516ms). Use TanStack Query for all data fetching, eliminate blocking awaits, and implement proper client/server separation.

userStories.title: Convert Server Component to Client Component with TanStack Query
userStories.description: The main performance bottleneck is src/app/world/[id]/page.tsx which is a Server Component doing synchronous database awaits. This blocks the entire page render. Convert to Client Component using TanStack Query for non-blocking data fetching.
acceptanceCriteria: Page component is now a Client Component ('use client' directive)
World data fetched via TanStack Query useQuery (non-blocking)
Initial render shows loading skeleton immediately
Data loads asynchronously without blocking render
userStories.notes: Current problem: await getWorldById() and await auth() block rendering for 1516ms. Solution: Use useQuery for world data, useSession for auth, render skeleton immediately.

userStories.title: Optimize getWorldById Server Action
userStories.description: The getWorldById function fetches too much data (user, layers, pins, loreEntries) even though not all is needed initially. Implement selective loading and consider caching.
acceptanceCriteria: Create getWorldByIdMinimal that fetches only essential fields (id, title, map)
Pins fetched separately via usePins hook (already implemented)
Add select for only needed fields (avoid fetching unused data)
userStories.notes: getWorldById includes pins and loreEntries but these should be fetched via TanStack Query in client components. Only fetch world metadata + layers in server action.

userStories.title: Implement React Query DevTools for Performance Monitoring
userStories.description: Add React Query DevTools in development to monitor query performance, identify slow queries, and track cache hits/misses.
acceptanceCriteria: ReactQueryDevtools component added to app layout
DevTools toggle button visible in corner
userStories.notes: Install @tanstack/react-query-devtools if not already installed. Add to src/app/layout.tsx or src/components/providers.tsx

userStories.title: Add Loading Skeletons for Better UX
userStories.description: While data loads via TanStack Query, show loading skeletons instead of blank screen. This improves perceived performance even if actual load time is similar.
acceptanceCriteria: Shows skeleton UI while world data loads
Skeleton mimics actual layout (sidebar, map area)
Error boundary with retry if query fails
userStories.notes: Use shadcn/ui Skeleton component or build custom. Should match WorldClient layout structure.

userStories.title: Remove Debug Console Logs
userStories.description: The debug console.log in page.tsx adds unnecessary overhead. Remove all debug logs from production code.
acceptanceCriteria: Search codebase for other debug console.logs
userStories.notes: Use grep to find all console.log statements. Keep error/warning logs, remove debug logs.

userStories.title: Optimize useWorldInitialization Hook
userStories.description: The useWorldInitialization hook transforms DB layer data to UI format on every render. Memoize the transformation to prevent unnecessary recalculations.
acceptanceCriteria: Benchmark shows improvement in React DevTools Profiler
userStories.notes: Add useMemo around the map transformation. Dependency array: [worldLayers].

userStories.title: Implement Suspense Boundaries for Progressive Loading
userStories.description: Wrap heavy components in React Suspense boundaries to load them progressively. This allows the page to render incrementally instead of waiting for all data.
acceptanceCriteria: Sidebar wrapped in Suspense with fallback
MapCanvas wrapped in Suspense with fallback
Pins data loaded separately via Suspense
Each section loads as data becomes available
userStories.notes: Next.js 13+ App Router supports Suspense. Use Suspense boundaries in WorldClient component.

userStories.title: Add Query Caching and Stale-Time Configuration
userStories.description: Configure proper staleTime and cacheTime for TanStack Query to minimize unnecessary refetches. Use stale data while revalidating in background.
acceptanceCriteria: World query: staleTime 5 minutes (world metadata rarely changes)
userStories.notes: Configure in usePins and create useWorld hook. Add QueryClientProvider with proper defaults in app layout.
